name_input: MESSER CUTTING SYSTEMS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/messer-cutting-systems-india-private-limited): "Total Shipments 21473 Records detected / Trading Partners 88 / Latest Cargo 2026-02-27" — but every visible row shows the company in the BUYER column, e.g. "2026-02-27 | MESSER CUTTING SYSTEMS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | GERMAN-GULF ENTERPRISES LTD | PLASMA CUTTING NOZZLES - 71616560-GRIVA 9000 A/PMYF 100-300 MM | SHARJAH, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 84689000 | BOL 1065976" and "2026-02-24 | ... | MIDDLE EAST INDUSTRIAL GASES CO. | SUPPLY OF WELDING SPARE PARTS -HEATING NOZZLE HF 12-PMYF | DAMMAM, SAUDI ARABIA | 84689000 | BOL 9948784". Source counter: page claims 21,473 shipment records; only 5 detail rows rendered in the free view, all import-side (origin UAE/Bahrain/Saudi Arabia -> destination Indian airports INBOM4/INBLR4/INMAA4). No row with the company as shipper/exporter, no export destination, no export HS code, no export B/L number was visible.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, trademo.com, eximpedia.app and volza.com all returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge; DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (searx: Connection refused) for the whole session, so no tender or GST pages could be located.
note: Import-side activity is real and dated (latest 2026-02-27, HS 84689000 cutting nozzles, B/L 1065976) — the company is an active importer/distributor of cutting and welding consumables, and ImportKey also lists it as a buyer of MESSER CUTTING SYSTEMS GMBH (3,778 shipments) and KJELLBERG FINSTERWALDE (2,309), consistent with an Indian subsidiary of the German Messer group. However, no export shipment record was found: the declared HS 841350 (reciprocating positive-displacement pumps) does not match any observed record — the observed codes are 84689000 (parts of welding/cutting machines), 90328990 and similar. Per project rules the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground; the factual code should be corrected to 84689000 for the observed trade. Domestic supply evidence: следов поставок на внутренний рынок не найдено в доступных источниках — GST turnover, GeM/CPPP contracts and annual-report splits are not public in the sources reachable here, so domestic_status is unknown, not confirmed. No revenue or export-volume figure is stated because none is public — left null rather than estimated. Registry/catalogue data deliberately not used as shipment evidence.
